metadata.title: End of Broadcast
metadata.medium: Chromogenic color print on baryta paper

exhibitionConstraints.artistAutonomyBoundary: No animated overlays directly superimposed on the photographic emulsion. Preparatory field contact prints appear only via side drawer or off-canvas viewport.

chapters.narrativeText: Observe the subtle transition between industrial stillness and twilight. Notice the grain structure achieved through analog medium-format film.

hotspots.title: Twilight Gradient
hotspots.description: The exact threshold between natural dusk and sodium-vapor lighting captured at 1/15th of a second.

chapters.narrativeText: Carlos Lobo reflects on wandering empty transmission towers at the borderlands: 'I waited four days for the specific fog density that would soften the steel silhouette.'

hotspots.title: Contact Sheet Drafts
hotspots.description: Six alternative framing exposures taken minutes prior to the final selected shot.

chapters.narrativeText: Filipa Loureiro contextualizes this work within contemporary Portuguese post-industrial topography, contrasting the technological transmission mast with territorial abandonment.

hotspots.title: Territorial Provenance
hotspots.description: Interactive map showing how this location intersects with adjacent photography in the exhibition room.
